modifications: Local typed registration and imports replace the DSH browser module loader.
Trajectory inspector mounts through a React portal into the shared Details panel.
Projection and image access are supplied by Polariton session-scoped adapters.
React 18.3.1 is shared across the application; TypeScript parameter properties are lowered for Node strip-types tests.
The server assistant accumulator resides in harness/native; browser accumulator and settlement retain DSH semantics.
Streaming Markdown uses the math grammar with quiet literal fallback for unfinished TeX.
Session-local trajectory selection survives component remounts.
Token formatter retains cache-hit percentage logic; unused localized count formatters are omitted.

Native trajectory, JSON and Markdown hints use the shared 11px/16px tooltip; body portals escape pane clipping, preserve anchor refs and handlers, expose aria-describedby, and support focus and Escape dismissal.
Polariton worker-origin input uses ordinary message and steering presentation while retaining distinct source metadata for native human-authority policies.
Polariton rename updates application-owned comments and authenticated worker source kind; upstream revisions and hashes remain unchanged.
ADR-033 reviews all 210 prior source entries against 0.2.1-rc.2; 93 upstream sources changed, and newly reachable source dependencies are included.
Polariton normalizes table matchers at its static registration boundary; no frontend Cordis service lifecycle or DSH browser loader is installed.
Successful assistant preparation retires at step/end; group-tree positions and lazy tool arguments follow current upstream semantics.
User content and reference documents use native ordered text rules with local read-only rendering and authenticated worker receipt ownership.

Polariton retains completion-time collapse, worker-scoped disclosures, its outer viewport and shared neutral menu/tooltip surfaces; optional upstream flow animation, plugin preference and desktop vibrancy services are excluded.
File classification is extracted from FileTypeIcon into a pure module shared by Markdown parsing and file-card rendering; both files retain their source provenance.
Metrics pills consume validated whole-session projections. Tool cards preserve recorded paths/cwd, nullable exit status and background acknowledgement semantics.
Code headers use static positioning inside Polariton translated virtual rows so sticky layout-space clamping cannot cover source lines; other code surfaces retain native sticky headers.
